{{Quote|How does the ''hunt'' progress?''"<br />"''The ''last unit'' is now in position in Smelter Bay Five, Governor Corwyth.|Governor Corwyth and Imperial Officer|<ref name="MSW30" />}}
'''Smelter Bay Five''' was a hanger bay for the large mobile ore vats that transported ore around the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Factory world/Legends|factory world]] of [[Metalorn/Legends|Metalorn]]. The ore conveyor traveled to this room, carrying the ore to be offloaded to the mobile ore vats. During the [[Mission to Metalorn (Galactic Civil War)|Mission to Metalorn]], [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] abandoned her tracked [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] on the ore conveyor, causing the Empire's agents to believe she was heading to Smelter Bay Five. In reality she had escaped in a different direction.
